# Alexandre Machado

> Personal site of Alexandre Machado, software engineer. Hosts links to his projects,
> writing, and social profiles, including the Audio Blackbox Android app.

## Projects

- [Audio Blackbox](https://alexandre.machado.cc/audio-blackbox/): Continuous ambient audio buffer for Android. Keeps a rolling buffer of up to the last ~45 minutes of audio in RAM and only writes to storage on demand, so nothing is recorded until you decide to keep it. 100% local processing, zero network egress.
- [Audio Blackbox on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cc.machado.audioblackbox): Official Play Store listing for the Audio Blackbox app.
- [Audio Blackbox source code](https://github.com/alexandre-machado/audio-blackbox): GitHub repository with the app's source code.
- [Audio Blackbox privacy policy](https://github.com/alexandre-machado/audio-blackbox/blob/main/docs/release/privacy-policy.md): Privacy policy describing the app's local-only, zero network egress data handling.
